remi_fin: Quick sync: proposing A/B price experiment for high-throughput SKU. Plan: 10% increase for treatment, 80/20 split for new signups, and opt-in grandfathering for legacy contracts. Draft price sheet: https://drive.company/fin/price-sheets/sku-high-2026-v3.csv

sam_ops: Ops asks: exclude reserved contracts, add soft QPS caps for treatment, and an auto-fallback if billing deltas >0.5% in 24h. Also limit variant to accounts <8M tokens/mo to reduce blast radius.

anya_eng: Tech notes: billing supports per-customer overrides. We'll need a backfill job for prorated credits (current invoice only) and Console flag for "grandfathered:true". Dry-run scheduled for 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z.

tina_sales: Sales requests a console column showing "grandfathered_until" and a 48h SLA for manual exception requests. We'll prepare an exceptions spreadsheet.

tariq_legal: Legal: will draft a short TOS blurb + opt-in wording. Need retention for opt-in records.

billingbot: Invoice snapshot coverage = 96.7%. Missing snapshots: acct_846, acct_901. Will flag for manual review.

remi_fin: Credit policy proposal: prorated credit for remainder of billing period only; no retro credits on closed invoices. Escalations to RevOps.

sam_ops: I'll post routing + capacity gating doc in #eng-infra by EOD. Also recommend staging throttle at 70% of historical peak for first 7 days.

anya_eng: Implementation plan: Console toggle + customer metadata change (boolean), backfill job that emits MANUAL_REVIEW for missing snapshots, dry-run -> manual review -> live. ETA for Console change = 3 business days.

tina_sales: Marketing will review two message templates: grandfather confirmation and treatment notice. Need copy by Thu.

remi_fin: Approvals needed: finance sign-off on credit policy, legal on messaging/TOS, product + eng on rollout. Target signoff by Friday COB to publish next Wed. Tagging @tariq_legal @tina_sales.
